verdict.rationale: Clerky publishes an official remote MCP server at mcp.clerky.com/mcp, with setup instructions for Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants. A live probe confirms the endpoint exists and is OAuth-gated. Missing for 10: tool coverage appears to be read-only and is not enumerated in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Once connected, the assistant can use available Clerky MCP tools with the team access you authorize.
live OAuth-gated remote MCP server, per docs read-only tools with team-scoped access
